name: The AI Productivity Playbook
shortDescription: A practical guide to using AI for everyday work—from emails, research, writing, meetings, and time management to data analysis, presentations, automation, and AI workflows.
fullDescription:
**📘 The AI Productivity Playbook**

The AI Productivity Playbook is a practical guide for anyone who wants to use AI to work faster, stay organized, and get more done.

Inside, you'll discover practical ways to use AI for email management, research, writing, meetings, time management, Excel & data, presentations, task automation, and AI-powered workflows.

Instead of focusing on complicated AI theory, this book focuses on real-world applications, practical examples, ready-to-use prompts, and simple workflows that you can apply to everyday work.

What You'll Learn
🤖 Understand the basics of AI and effective prompting
📧 Write, summarize, organize, and manage emails
🔎 Research and summarize information faster
✍️ Create better content and professional documents
🎙️ Prepare for and summarize meetings
⏰ Plan your time and stay focused
📊 Analyze data and work smarter with Excel
🎯 Create better presentations in less time
⚙️ Automate repetitive tasks
🔗 Build powerful AI workflows

Whether you're a student, freelancer, creator, professional, entrepreneur, or business owner, this playbook is designed to help you turn AI from a simple chatbot into a practical productivity partner.

Use AI. Verify AI. Improve your workflow. 🚀

The AI Productivity Playbook — 2026 Edition
By Omove Store

name: AI Thumbnail Prompts

fullDescription:

These prompts help you generate clean, eye-catching, professional, and high-CTR thumbnail concepts without spending hours figuring out what to write.

What's Included:

Ready-to-use AI thumbnail prompts
Prompts for different YouTube niches and styles
Cinematic and realistic thumbnail concepts
High-impact composition and lighting instructions

Beginner-friendly and easy to customize

Save time, improve your thumbnail ideas, and create more professional-looking thumbnails with AI. 🚀
